rec-e1.subject: Sikubulungele indawo yakho ku-Gadit
rec-e1.body:
Lotjha {name},

Uthome ukubhalisela i-{plan}, wema ngaphambi kobana uqede.

Sikubulungele koke, begodu ungaragela phambili khona lapho ume khona.

- Amalanga ali-14 mahala, begodu akukho okubhadeliswako namhlanje
- Ngemva kokulinga: {price}
- Sizakuthumelela isikhumbuzo nge-imeyili ngaphambi kobana ukulinga kuphele
- Ungakhansela nanyana kunini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti, ngokuthinta kabili
rec-e1.next: Kukhona okungakhanyi? Phendula nje i-imeyili le, sizakusiza.

rec-e2-family.subject: Lokho abantwana bakho abakuthola ku-Gadit
rec-e2-family.body:
Lotjha {name},

Besifuna ukukutjela kafitjhani bona yini elindele abantwana bakho ku-Gadit:

Ilizwi ngalinye abahlangana nalo, ebhukwini, emsebenzini wekhaya namkha ekukhulumeni, liba lilizwi abalizwisisa kwamambala.

- Ihlathululo esezingeni lomntwana wakho, enesithombe sehlathululo ngayinye
- Imidlalo nokuzilolonga okwenziwe ngamezwi wabo
- Isizo ngomsebenzi wekhaya
- Ideshibhodi yababelethi ekutjengisa ituthuko yomntwana ngamunye

Ukubhalisela kwakho i-{plan} kubulungiwe, begodu kusele igadango lokugcina kwaphela.
rec-e2-family.next: Akukho okubhadeliswako namhlanje, begodu ungakhansela nanyana kunini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

rec-e2-indiv.subject: Lokho okulindele wena ku-Gadit
rec-e2-indiv.body:
Lotjha {name},

Besifuna ukukutjela kafitjhani bona yini ekulindeleko ku-Gadit:

Ilizwi ngalinye, ebhukwini, emsebenzini namkha ekukhulumeni, liba lilizwi olizwisisa ngokupheleleko.

- Zoke iinhlathululo zelizwi, ngesithombe sehlathululo ngayinye
- Imidlalo nokuzilolonga okwenziwe ngamezwi wakho
- Ibhuku lakho lamezwi elibulunga koke okufundileko

Ukubhalisela kwakho i-{plan} kubulungiwe, begodu kusele igadango lokugcina kwaphela.
rec-e2-indiv.next: Akukho okubhadeliswako namhlanje, begodu ungakhansela nanyana kunini ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

rec-e3.subject: Kukhona okukuthikazileko? Sitjele
rec-e3.body:
Lotjha {name},

Ukubhalisela kwakho i-{plan} kusabulungiwe.

Nange kukhona okukubambako, phendula nje i-imeyili le, sizakusiza.

act-first-word-family.subject: Ilizwi lokuthoma labantwana bakho ku-Gadit
act-first-word-family.body:
Lotjha {name},

Indlela engcono khulu yokuthoma: hlala nomntwana wakho imizuzu emihlanu, nifune ilizwi linye ahlangane nalo namhlanje, ebhukwini, emsebenzini wekhaya namkha ekukhulumeni.

- Tlola ilizwi endaweni yokufuna
- Bona ihlathululo esezingeni lomntwana wakho, enesithombe sehlathululo ngayinye
- Libulunge ebhukwini lamezwi, begodu ukusukela lapho lingena emidlalweni yakhe

Ilizwi linye namhlanje, begodu umntwana wakho sele athoma ukwakha amezwi wakhe.
act-first-word-family.next: Utlhoga isizo? Phendula nje i-imeyili le.

act-first-word-indiv.subject: Ilizwi lakho lokuthoma ku-Gadit
act-first-word-indiv.body:
Lotjha {name},

Indlela engcono khulu yokuthoma: funa ilizwi linye ohlangane nalo namhlanje, ebhukwini, emsebenzini namkha ekukhulumeni.

- Zoke iinhlathululo zalo, ngesithombe sehlathululo ngayinye
- Lapho ilizwi livela khona
- Libulunge ebhukwini lakho lamezwi bese uzilolonga ngalo emidlalweni emifitjhani

Ilizwi linye namhlanje, begodu amezwi wakho sele akhula.
act-first-word-indiv.next: Utlhoga isizo? Phendula nje i-imeyili le.

act-first-word-2.subject: Ilizwi linye, imizuzu emihlanu
act-first-word-2.body:
Lotjha {name},

Umbono omncani wanamhlanje: khetha ilizwi linye ebhukwini, emsebenzini wekhaya namkha ezindabeni, bese ulifuna ku-Gadit.

Ngomzuzu nje ubona zoke iinhlathululo zalo, ngesithombe nezibonelo, begodu libulungwa ebhukwini lamezwi bona uzilolonge.

Kungendlela le amezwi akhula ngayo: ilizwi linye ngesikhathi.
act-first-word-2.next: Utlhoga isizo? Phendula nje i-imeyili le.

act-add-child.subject: Elinye igadango: engeza umntwana wakho
act-add-child.body:
Lotjha {name},

I-Gadit Family yakhelwe abantwana bakho, kodwana akukabi khona umntwana owengezwe ku-akhawunti. Kuthatha umzuzu:

- Tlola ibizo lomntwana wakho bese ukhetha umlingiswa
- Hlanganisa idivayisi yakhe ngaphandle kwephasiwedi, namkha usebenzise iModi yabantwana kudivayisi yakho
- Ukusukela lapho ilizwi ngalinye alifunako liyabulungwa, begodu ubona ituthuko edeshibhodini yababelethi
act-add-child.next: Utlhoga isizo? Phendula nje i-imeyili le.

act-return-family.subject: Ukuthoma okufitjhani ku-Gadit, okwenzelwe wena
act-return-family.body:
Lotjha {name},

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa bona abantwana bakho bathola koke i-Gadit engabanikela khona. Nanga amagadango amathathu afitjhani wokuthoma iveke le:

- Engeza umntwana ku-akhawunti, nange ungakakwenzi (umzuzu munye)
- Funani ilizwi linye ndawonye ebhukwini namkha emsebenzini wekhaya
- Vula imidlalo, eyenziwe ngamezwi abulungwe ngumntwana wakho
act-return-family.next: Ufuna sikutjengise bona isebenza njani? Phendula i-imeyili le, begodu sizakuhlela ikulumiswano efitjhani yefowuni yemizuzu eli-10.

act-return-indiv.subject: Ukuthoma okufitjhani ku-Gadit, okwenzelwe wena
act-return-indiv.body:
Lotjha {name},

Sifuna ukuqinisekisa bona uthola koke i-Gadit engakunikela khona. Nanga amagadango amathathu afitjhani wokuthoma iveke le:

- Funa ilizwi linye ohlangane nalo namhlanje
- Libulunge ebhukwini lakho lamezwi
- Zilolonge ngamezwi wakho emidlalweni emifitjhani
act-return-indiv.next: Ufuna sikutjengise bona isebenza njani? Phendula i-imeyili le, begodu sizakuhlela ikulumiswano efitjhani yefowuni yemizuzu eli-10.
